name: whalers-scan
description: Daily fantasy-hockey data for the Hartford Whalers (Fantrax league The Hockey Life): a 16-league minors scan matched to Fantrax plus league, box-score and alert files, written to data/ by GitHub Actions.

scripts.check: for f in engine/*.js src/*.js src/lib/*.js src/tools/*.js src/ci/*.js test/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
